headline: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to let AI agents review and fix code
summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Ship, a new product letting Claude AI agents review, fix and approve pull requests and ship code changes on their own. The feature builds on Claude's existing Code Review capability, and TechCrunch notes it aims to remove a routine-approval bottleneck as AI-generated code piles up.
